beaches.name: Plakias (east end)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised at the south-eastern end of Plakias Bay. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2001 to July 2023 with nudity at 80-100% in that dune-screened section; a 2021 directory entry and Greek listicles (2021-2024) agree. A 2019 report relays a sunbed attendant's claim that the beach is officially nudist, with no authority named.

beaches.name: Ammoudaki (Mikro Ammoudi)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers share this organised cove between Damnoni and Ammoudi. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to 2020 putting nudity between 20% and 99% depending on season and crowd; a Crete beach guide and a 2024 Greek listicle call it a nudist beach. A 2021 directory entry calls it official but names no authority.

beaches.name: Agios Pavlos (Sandhills, western beach)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the beaches over the headland west of the main beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to July 2023, with the first cove mixed and the long western beach mostly nude; a second directory repeats the 2023 reports and a Rethymnon beach guide calls the dunes suitable for nudism. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Ligres
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised beyond the rocks east of the taverna and at Katsouni. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1999 to August 2020; a Crete beach guide names Katsouni as the nudist cove and Greek listicles (2021-2024) list Ligres as nudist-friendly. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Triopetra (west of the rocks)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the long western stretch beyond the cantina and rocks. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2004 to August 2020, typically 50-100% nude on weekdays; no report from the last three years was found. No designation or signage is documented.
